offers_products.reason: Main offering is leased space; it develops properties to hold and lease, not to sell as products.

offers_services.reason: As a REIT it leases and manages office, lab and mixed-use space, with property management and development services; REITs count as services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Main customers are business tenants. Hotel, restaurant and multifamily offerings reach individuals but are minor.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Tenants are companies and institutions leasing office, lab and co-working space in Philadelphia, Washington DC and Austin.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is rent from multi-year office and lab leases, with tenants staying for decades.

cyclical_demand.reason: Office and lab tenants can downsize, delay expansion or not renew leases in downturns; development is also cyclical.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay recurring rent on leased office and lab space; leases are ongoing payments rather than one-time purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue is rent from owned buildings; the properties are the asset, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Tenants are a broad mix of office, lab and life science companies, many mid-sized, with no focus on large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: REIT owning and developing 19 million sq ft of office, lab and mixed-use properties requiring heavy ongoing capital.

notes: Judged as an office/lab landlord REIT; hotels, co-working and residential are minor parts.
